        external
        view
        override
        returns (uint256)
    {
        return
            tokenReceive == token0.token
                ? SwapUtils.calculateWithdrawOneToken(
                    tokenAmount,
                    token0,
                    token1,
                    amplificationParams,
                    feeParams,
                    lpToken
                )
                : SwapUtils.calculateWithdrawOneToken(
                    tokenAmount,
                    token1,
                    token0,
                    amplificationParams,
                    feeParams,
                    lpToken
                );
    }
